data.text: Checklist for 0.8.1 before the tag: 1,351 passed and 1 skipped of 1,352 (the first run failed 2 in agent-package.test.ts until scripts/agent-package.mjs regenerated the plugin manifest at 0.8.1 — the test doing its job); typecheck clean; npm audit --omit=dev clean; npm pack --dry-run has no .kadence/. Medians of nine on Node 25: --version 76 ms, prime 126, ready 123, task list 110, search 162 — all under 200. board --json is 287 KB and parses through a pipe. Nothing under src/tui changed since v0.8.0, so no TUI pass by hand. Criterion 1 (tests first) does not apply: a release changes no behaviour. 17 journal events already in the working tree from 2026-10-04 (a DOC-41 revision naming a person, two notes, criterion toggles on KAD-12, a move and back) are left out of the release commit for the owner to judge under DOC-64 §3.
